decision.title: Decision Studio
decision.subtitle: Compare certified deployment scenarios and explore how priorities change the preferred model–evidence configuration.
decision.context: 18 configurations · 5 certified scenarios · quality, reliability and efficiency trade-offs
decision.choose_three: Choose up to three configurations to compare.
decision.quality_first_description: Prioritizes end-to-end quality and performance on weaker cases.
decision.reliability_first_description: Considers only configurations that complete all planned generations.
decision.balanced_description: Balances average quality, lower-tail reliability and deployment efficiency.
decision.efficiency_aware_description: Favors lower latency and token use while preserving certified quality constraints.
decision.independence_sensitive_description: Maintains relatively high quality while reducing lexical-overlap signal.
decision.utility_caveat: Utility is a scenario-specific decision-support score, not a probability or confidence measure.
decision.pareto_boundary: Pareto-efficient among observed certified options; this does not establish statistical superiority.
decision.boundary_rank: Decision rank places eligible, scored Pareto-efficient options first and then orders them by utility.
decision.boundary_utility_rank: Utility rank is the direct descending order of scenario utility among eligible scored options.
decision.boundary_utility: Utility is not a probability or significance measure.
decision.boundary_pareto: Pareto efficiency does not establish superiority.
decision.boundary_template: Template Reference and alternative measurement releases are not ranked.
decision.boundary_missing: Human trust, naturalness and monetary cost are not included.
decision.what_if_warning: Custom weights do not redefine certified research findings or statistical results.
decision.positive_weight: At least one criterion must have a positive weight.
decision.changed_objective: The preferred configuration changes because the custom weight vector defines a different objective.
decision.retains_recommendation: The custom priorities retain the certified recommendation.
decision.zero_vector: No ranking is produced for an all-zero weight vector.
decision.tradeoff_subtitle: Observed performance and deployment proxies across 18 configurations
decision.preferred_subtitle: Normalized criterion values multiplied by certified scenario weights
decision.ranking_explanation: Decision rank places eligible, scored Pareto-efficient options first and then orders them by utility. Utility rank shows the direct descending utility order.
decision.what_if_profile: How custom priorities change the utility profile
decision.what_if_profile_subtitle: Certified Balanced contributions versus user-specified contributions

decision.unavailable_criteria: Unavailable criteria — monetary cost, human trust, naturalness and stochastic stability — are excluded because the certified study does not support ranking them.

decision.not_tested: Statistical advantage is not established against every comparator

RQ1.title: Primary operational effectiveness
RQ1.question: How do narrative model, controlled evidence condition, and their interaction affect end-to-end operational faithfulness across all planned LLM generations?
RQ1.unit: canonical case with repeated model and evidence conditions
RQ1.restriction_1: Do not treat claims as independent observations
RQ1.restriction_2: Do not assume S0-S5 is a linear ordinal scale

RQ2.title: Conditional quality and structured missingness
RQ2.question: Among usable generations, how do semantic faithfulness and verifiability differ across models and evidence conditions, and are conclusions robust to structured S4 failures?
RQ2.population: 638 usable generations with 27 complete canonical cases for balanced sensitivity
RQ2.restriction_1: Never impute conditional scores for unusable generations
RQ2.restriction_2: Missingness is structured pipeline failure, not MCAR

RQ3.title: Evidence utilization and mechanisms
RQ3.question: Which evidence-exposure, narrative-policy, and claim-level mechanisms explain variation in operational faithfulness across models, evidence conditions, and case strata?
RQ3.population: 648 LLM generations, 216 evidence packages, 2941 evidence items, and 14667 validated claims
RQ3.unit: descriptive generation, evidence package, claim, or canonical case as explicitly labeled
RQ3.restriction_1: Safe-phrase overlap is a lexical signal, not proof of copying
RQ3.restriction_2: Mechanism analyses are explanatory associations, not causal effects

RQ4.title: Deployment trade-offs
RQ4.question: What quality, reliability, and efficiency trade-offs distinguish the 18 LLM model-evidence options, and which options are preferred under explicit deployment priorities?
RQ4.population: 18 LLM model-evidence options across five frozen decision scenarios
RQ4.restriction_1: Utility is a preference-based score, not probability or significance
RQ4.restriction_2: What-if outputs are user-specified scenarios, not certified findings

RQ5.title: Measurement robustness
RQ5.question: How sensitive are the principal findings to the selected claim-measurement artifact release?
RQ5.restriction_1: Do not claim V4 is more correct without human calibration
RQ5.restriction_2: Artifact dependence must be reported as a material limitation

RQ6.title: Deterministic Template Baseline extension
RQ6.question: Compared with a deterministic non-LLM template under the same controlled evidence, what incremental informational value do LLM narratives provide, and what reliability and structural-efficiency costs accompany that value?
RQ6.population: 216 Template Baseline generations paired with 648 LLM generations
RQ6.restriction_1: Template Baseline is not a fourth LLM and is excluded from decision ranking
RQ6.restriction_2: Structured template claim extraction is deterministic but not identical to the LLM extraction channel
RQ6.restriction_3: Naturalness, usefulness, and trust require human evaluation
RQ6.restriction_4: Template latency at zero milliseconds is measurement-floor limited
